newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Industry group calls for Australian rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Industry group calls for Australian rate cut.

text.p: Australian Chamber of Industry and Commerce chief executive Mark Paterson called on Wednesday for a further interest rate cut, following a September quarter fall in the underlying inflation rate.
Paterson said in a statement there was now no reason to wait to lower interest rates.

"Interest rates should come down as soon possible to prevent further harm to the Australian economy and to assist in the restoration of business and consumer confidence," Paterson said in a statement.
Paterson also called for a reassessment of wage claims and agreements, saying any increase above 2.1 percent must be financed out of faster productivity growth.
Underlying inflation rose 0.5 percent in the September quarter for an annual 2.4 percent rise. This compared with an annual underlying inflation rate of 3.1 percent in the June quarter.
The Reserve Bank of Australia last cut rates on July 31, by half a percentage point to 7.0 percent.
